Definition: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.
BiblicalUsage: Niger is Simeon, called Niger, one of the prophets and teachers of the church at Antioch. He stands in the list with Barnabas and Saul, Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen — the men who fast and pray and send the first missionaries out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church at Antioch shows what a mixed company can do: Simeon called Niger is named among the teachers, and the gospel goes out from their prayer.
